caption:
Full-grain leather or bonded: one of these two swatches is mostly plastic.

From the top they both pass. The tells are at the cut edge and on the back. Full-grain is one fibrous layer edge to edge and shows suede on the reverse. Bonded is a polyurethane skin over pressed leather scrap and cloth, and the cloth shows at the cut.

The grain gives a hint too. Real hide is irregular and matte. An embossed skin repeats and picks up a slight sheen.

Illustrated here so you know what to look for. Check the real thing in the shop.

Save this for the sofa showroom.
